decisions.reason: It remained on its own webpage in 2024 and fits the firm's core platform and analytics direction, so prior visible commitment and likely reusable development effort make management inclined to continue it.

Its downgrade from a standalone page to only a website mention suggests weaker momentum, but because it is close to the firm's established tariff-calculation business and already developed, management is still somewhat more likely to retain than abandon it.

Although it was less prominently marketed in 2024, it builds on the firm's established offer and can support the broader platform and related applications, which makes continued commitment more likely than withdrawal.
